description: For the referencesource Muse connector only (bearer token required). Records the result of a task fetched with next_task_for_muse. `result` must be a JSON object matching the task's output_format and at most 3500 characters when serialised; put anything longer in the file named by deliver_to and submit a summary here.

note.description: Optional: what was hard, what was skipped, what a human should know.

result.description: The result, matching the task's output_format.

name: submit_task_result

stored.description: analytics (durable) or none (no store bound: the file copy is the record)

title: Submit a task result
